Name: TKO Percussion TKO Percussion 5-Piece Junior Drum Set Prism Blue
Natural: This set is made by TKO, one of the best names in student and intermediate drum sets! Suitable for ages 3-10, this great, affordable 5-piece set is perfect for young beginning and advancing drummers looking for a first 5-piece drum set! This drum set is not a toy like many drum sets in this price range. The TKO101 is a Real 5-piece Drum Set and is ready to be rocked! This complete TKO 5-Piece Junior children's drum set looks just like the ones grown-ups use! This set provides a full 5-piece setup and features the great sound and quality that has made TKO one of the top names in beginner/intermediate drum sets. This drum set is made specifically for smaller drummers (age 3-10) who have advanced beyond the 3-piece drum set stage but are not yet ready for larger, more expensive advanced drum sets. This highly durable, top quality drum set, will easily hold up to your child's playing. The TKO101 features fully tunable top and bottom heads, real wood shells and chrome plated metal hardware! The snare drum (10") and adjustible angle small toms (8" & 10") have 4 lugs each. The floor tom (13") and bass drum (16") have 6 lugs each. Also Includes: tilting cymbal stand, snare drum stand, and drum stool (all adjustable height), spring-loaded bass drum pedal, brass cymbal, cymbal arm, hi-hat stand with a pair of 8" brass hi-hat cymbals, drum sticks and tuning key. Recommended for ages 3 to 10. Makes a wonderful music gift for kids! Replacement parts are also available. Some assembly is needed for this drum set. Easy set-up instructions are included.
